rule: Never change English site text without the matching Greek change in the same change.

guards.name: site checks: both languages have the same keys (site check 1)

note: A fresh instance started in the clone. It changed the Greek twin without being asked and flagged it for a native speaker's review, as CONTRIBUTING.md asks. It regenerated the clone's made-up site data (ignored by git).
report:
I changed the calculator's privacy line in English and, as the project rules require, in Greek too. Every check I ran passed.

## What changed (2 files)

- **`site/src/i18n/en.json`**, key `calc.private`: "Nothing you enter leaves your device." became "Nothing you type is sent anywhere: it stays on this device."
- **`site/src/i18n/el.json`**, same key: "Τίποτα από όσα εισάγετε δε φεύγει από τη συσκευή σας." became "Τίποτα από όσα πληκτρολογείτε δεν αποστέλλεται πουθενά: μένει σε αυτή τη συσκευή."
  - You only asked for the English. I changed the Greek because the rules say every English text change gets its Greek twin in the same change, and the build fails on a missing translation.
  - The Greek is my own wording, written to match the new English. The site only offers Greek once a native speaker has reviewed it, so please have it checked.

The calculator page is the only place this key is used. I checked the built pages (`site/dist/en/...` and `site/dist/el/.../calculator/index.html`) and both show the new line.

## What I ran
- `tests/sitedata.py site/public/data`: wrote 411 files of made-up data. This folder is git-ignored, so the regenerated data isn't part of the change.
- `npm run check`: type check had 0 errors and 0 warnings. Vitest passed 137 of 137 tests in 19 files. The build made 149 pages, and "All site checks passed."
- `npm run test:ui` (Playwright): 546 passed, 10 skipped, none failed.
- `npm run format:check`: all files use Prettier style. `npm run lint` exited 0.
- `ruff format --check`: 216 files already formatted. `ruff check`: all checks passed.

## What I didn't do
- **No wording-change issue.** The rules say wording changes need a maintainer's agreement in an issue. I took your direct request as that agreement, and opened no issue.
- **Similar text elsewhere left alone.** "Nothing you enter leaves your device, and nothing is saved." on the "find your group" page (key `find.private`) is a different line, so I didn't touch it. The comment at `site/src/styles/global.css:1873` also still quotes the old wording; it's only a comment, so I left it unchanged.
- **No Python tests.** No Python code changed, so I didn't run `pytest`.
- **No commit, push or pull request.**
